nyctaginaceous.m: Belonging to the family Nyctaginaceae of flowering plants.

nyctalopic.m: Unable to see clearly in low light.

nyctitropic.m: Turning or bending at night into different positions.

nymphae.m: More than one nymph. nymph: a minor nature goddess usually depicted as a beautiful maiden.

nymphaeum.m: A shrine consecrated to water nymphs, often with a fountain.

nymphal.m: Of or pertaining to a nymph or nymphs.

nymphean.m: Of or pertaining to a nymph or nymphs.

nympholeptic.m: Of, or relating to, or having characteristics of an instance of nympholepsy.

nystagmic.m: Exhibiting or pertaining to nystagmus (involuntary eye movement).
